plat.title: aphrody.app, the Aphrody publishing platform
plat.desc: Aphrody's publishing platform: one preview address per version, publish and roll back in seconds, cookie-free statistics and speed measured on real visitors.
plat.lead: Every version of a site gets its own address to be reviewed. When it is right, it goes live. If a problem appears, the previous version comes back within seconds.
plat.f1.d: Every version of a site gets its own preview address, to review and share before it goes live.
plat.f2.d: A published version never changes again. Switching to another one, newer or older, takes seconds.
plat.f3.d: Page views, referrers, countries and device types, with no cookie and no visitor identifier.
plat.f4.d: Loading time, responsiveness and stability of the page, taken from real visits and tracked over time.
plat.f5.d: Every image is sent at the displayed size and in the lightest format the browser can read.
plat.f6.d: Banners, options and switches change live, without building a new version.
plat.f7.d: Every site keeps its own address, encrypted with HTTPS.
plat.f8.d: The course of every release stays available, step by step.
